jobs.title: Associate Director - AI Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/08/2026 Description #### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. #### **What you’ll be doing…** You’ll lead engineering delivery for two foundational pillars of Verizon’s enterprise AI Platform — the Adaptive Intelligence Gateway that routes every AI request across all business units and the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) that governs how AI agents are built, registered, and deployed. You’ll manage a team of 3–5 engineers, own the engineering roadmap, and translate platform architecture into production\-grade services that thousands of Verizon developers depend on. * Owning AI Gateway engineering. Design and deliver intelligent model routing, multi\-provider failover (Google Vertex, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI), per\-BU FinOps and chargeback, semantic caching, and self\-service tenant onboarding on a Kubernetes/Istio foundation with JWT\-driven multi\-tenant namespace isolation. * Delivering the Agent Development Lifecycle. Ship the Agent Registry with zero\-trust identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE), the Verizon Agent SDK with pre\-integrated LLMOps/FinOps/guardrails, the MCP Tool Gateway, and an ArgoCD\-managed DevSecOps pipeline with canary deployments and auto\-rollback. * Hitting the SLAs that keep the platform trusted. 99\.9% Gateway uptime, \=2,000ms P95 latency, Mean Time to Agent Deploy reduced from 21 days to \=7 days, 95%\+ Agent \& Registry Compliance. * Driving enterprise consolidation and cost control. Consolidate 8\+ independent BU AI integrations onto one managed gateway, enable real\-time cost attribution, and unlock $500K\+ quarterly optimization savings through intelligent routing. * Onboarding the business. Land 5\+ BU teams on the platform within 6 months, ship Agent Registry GA and SDK v1\.0, and establish the engineering operating cadence with Architecture, Operations, and BU consumers. * Leading the team. Recruit, coach, and grow a team of 3–5 platform engineers; set the engineering bar, review designs, and remove blockers so the team ships. #### **What we’re looking for…** #### **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Technical leadership experience managing software or platform engineers. * Experience running Kubernetes at production scale. * Experience operating in multi\-cloud environments (GCP and AWS). * Experience with AI/ML infrastructure: model serving (vLLM, LLM Gateways, or equivalent), inference optimization, and LLMOps. * Experience building developer platforms — SDKs, CLIs, developer portals, or self\-service onboarding. * Experience with FinOps or cost allocation models (chargeback, budget enforcement, usage attribution). #### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an MBA. * Experience with API gateway patterns: JWT authentication, rate limiting, traffic splitting, circuit breakers, and mTLS * Software or platform engineering experience. * Experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, or similar). * Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent\-to\-Agent) standards. * Experience implementing zero\-trust security (SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA/Rego). * Experience with CDC pipelines and event\-driven data platforms (BigQuery, Kafka). * Experience delivering platforms in a telecom or large regulated enterprise (CPNI, PCI\-DSS, SOX). * Experience designing Responsible AI guardrails, evaluation pipelines, or model governance. * Experience with observability stacks (Jaeger, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or BigQuery\-based). * Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, CKA/CKAD. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. #### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. #### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. #### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.The salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $126,000\.00 \- $242,000\.00\. Salary126,000\.00 \- 242,000\.00 Annual Type Full\-time

jobs.description: Posted Date 9/08/2026 Description #### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. #### **What you’ll be doing…** As the Principal Architect for Verizon’s Enterprise AI Platform, you will provide technical leadership for a comprehensive 5\-layer architecture serving all global business units. Your primary mandate is to ensure architectural coherence across the ecosystem, aligning Gateway routing with the Registry’s RBAC models, integrating the ADLC pipeline with established guardrail frameworks, and providing end\-to\-end token visibility for FinOps. In this capacity, you will author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), spearhead Architecture Review Board (ARB) submissions, and conduct rigorous build\-vs\-buy analyses supported by multi\-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models. This principal\-level individual contributor role requires the ability to exert technical influence and drive consensus across the organization through design excellence and strategic vision. * Direct the 5\-layer architecture stack — Encompassing Model Foundation, Agent Factory, Agent Runtime, Experience, and Control Plane layers. Responsibilities include defining formal layer boundaries, interface contracts, and interaction patterns to ensure platform scalability. * Establish and govern architectural standards — Defining API conventions, enterprise security patterns, and observability requirements. Lead component reviews and provide consultative oversight for Business Unit agent architectures to ensure platform alignment. * Lead technical strategy and procurement evaluations — Executing complex build\-vs\-buy analyses for platform components and develop comprehensive 3\-year TCO models. Formulate multi\-cloud strategies balancing central platform services with decentralized requirements. * Architect enterprise security and governance frameworks — Designing multi\-stage security flows encompassing identity, authentication, execution safety, and audit. Engineer Responsible AI (RAI) guardrail architectures and ensure compliance with emerging international regulations. * Stakeholder engagement and pattern evangelization — Collaborating with executive leadership and external cloud partners on capacity planning and integration. Contribute high\-impact reference architectures to the enterprise library to drive architectural maturity. #### **What we’re looking for…** **What you'll be doing…** Principal\-level architect with a demonstrated focus on technical interface contracts and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modeling. Candidates must possess a proven history of designing scalable distributed platforms and establishing architectural credibility with both executive leadership and engineering teams through rigorous Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Deep technical proficiency in Large Language Model (LLM) architecture—including attention mechanisms, KV\-cache, context windows, and token economics—is required, alongside the ability to substantiate build\-vs\-buy recommendations with robust, 3\-year financial models. jobs.title: Failure Analysis Engineer (Onsite - Acton, MA)
jobs.description: Job Summary The Failure Analysis Engineer is responsible for investigating failures and quality issues involving medical devices to identify root causes and support product and process improvements. This hands\-on role works closely with Quality, Manufacturing, Post\-Market, Supplier Quality, and Engineering teams to analyze returned products, manufacturing nonconformances, complaints, and test data, while documenting findings in technical reports and quality system records. Key responsibilities include conducting root cause investigations, analyzing failure trends, reviewing manufacturing and device history records, supporting CAPAs and quality processes, and assisting with audits and regulatory inspections. Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering and 3 to 5 years of experience in engineering, quality, reliability, or failure analysis, preferably in the medical device industry, along with strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical writing, and communication skills. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI-Native Developer Platform
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit's 8,000\+ developers build products that power the financial lives of hundreds of millions of people. PDX — Platform Developer Experience is the team that makes those developers faster, safer, and more effective. Our north star is 3x Developer Velocity: measurably tripling the speed at which developers move from idea to production — not through incremental tooling improvements, but through a fundamental shift to AI\-native, Done\-For\-You platform experiences. We're looking for a Staff PM who can operate at the intersection of strategy and execution across multiple platform layers simultaneously — infrastructure, operational intelligence, developer tooling, and production reliability. You won't just define what gets built. You'll shape how PDX thinks about AI\-native platform design, define the measurement frameworks that show up in company\-wide goal reporting, and move 8,000 developers faster by changing the platform beneath them. This role sits at the frontier of how enterprise developer platforms are evolving: from infrastructure teams that ship APIs, to intelligence teams that ship AI\-native experiences directly in developer workflows. If that transition excites you, read on. Why This Role Is Exciting * You'll operate across multiple platform layers simultaneously — infrastructure, data intelligence, developer tooling — each with different users, adoption motions, and success metrics * You must drive adoption without mandate across 8,000\+ developers and dozens of platform teams * You're defining new interaction models (natural language interfaces, MCP\-based tooling, agentic workflows) — not iterating on existing ones * Success requires changing developer behavior at scale, not just shipping features * You'll own measurement frameworks that directly feed executive\-level goal reporting — the numbers have to be right, and the story has to be clear The 3x Developer Velocity Mission 3x is not a slogan — it's a design constraint. Every platform capability PDX builds is evaluated against one question: does this meaningfully reduce time spent on toil across the developer lifecycle? As Staff PM, you will own the measurement framework that makes 3x visible and credible: * Inner Loop: Lead Time to Change, PR Merge Velocity, Coding Start Time * Outer Loop: Deploy Time, Incident Resolution, Infrastructure Config Time * RDR Loop: Change Failure Rate, MTTR, Agent\-Driven Proficiency * Your products should move these numbers. Your dashboards should prove it. What You'll Own This role will focus on one or two of the following areas based on candidate strengths and business priorities, while influencing the broader PDX ecosystem as a Staff\-level contributor. * ODL Intelligence — Unlocking Intuit's Operational Data Lake (Key Strategic Investment) Transform Intuit's Operational Data Lake from a resource accessible only to SQL experts into an AI\-native, self\-serve intelligence platform — where any PM, TPM, developer, or engineering leader gets operational insights in seconds using natural language. Own the product strategy across five pillars: DFY Ingestion, Data Catalog \& Consumption, AI/ML Enablement, Mid\-Market Readiness, and Scalable Governance. Drive MCP server integration, semantic catalogs, and natural language\-to\-Athena SQL interfaces. This is one of the highest\-leverage intelligence bets in PDX — unlocking Dev360, FinOps, GenAI, and operational decision\-making across the company. * AI\-Native Developer Tooling \& MCP Ecosystem Define and launch MCP servers that bring platform capabilities — cloud provisioning, load testing, chaos injection, metric queries, DR orchestration — directly into developer IDEs, eliminating context switching entirely. Own Intuit's MCP Marketplace strategy, drive adoption across Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf, and grow the innersource skills ecosystem that accelerates AI adoption across the PM and engineering community. * Cloud Abstraction \& Network Infrastructure Own the shift from IaC\-heavy provisioning to platform\-managed, IDE\-first developer experiences — where infrastructure is described, not configured. Drive Done\-For\-You cloud abstraction, self\-serve VPC management, IPv6 readiness, and compliance\-by\-default guardrails (PCI\-DSS, SOX, SOC2\). Target outcomes: 70%\+ reduction in provisioning time, elimination of manual CloudOps toil, and a foundation for agentic cloud operations. * Production Reliability — DR, Chaos \& Performance Own the platform's proactive reliability posture across three interconnected areas: enterprise\-scale DR orchestration (multi\-workload failover, AI\-generated recovery procedures), chaos engineering (Smart FMEA, CI/CD\-integrated chaos stages, shift\-left resiliency enforcement), and performance engineering (cloud\-native load testing, auto\-generated scripts, IDE\-embedded testing via MCP). Drive the organizational shift from reactive incident response to prevention at code time. Change Management — cutive forums, publish thought leadership internally and externally, and represent PDX's platform vision in the cloud\-native community (CNCF, open source) * Convert **high\-ambiguity charters** into clear strategies, executable roadmaps. **Qualifications** **Technical Skills** * 7\+ years of PM experience in platform products at scale, with hands\-on ownership of distributed systems environments * Working knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS preferred): VPC architecture, IAM, Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio/Envoy), CI/CD, and compliance frameworks (PCI\-DSS, SOX, SOC2\) * Familiarity with operational data platforms: data lakes, Athena, Redshift, or equivalent — including schema design, query patterns, and access control * Experience with or strong understanding of AI/ML developer tooling: MCP servers, LLM\-powered workflows, agent\-based systems, or IDE\-embedded AI experiences * Awareness of load testing, chaos engineering, DORA metrics, and reliability engineering practices **Product Management Skills** * Track record of shipping platform products with measurable adoption and business impact across large engineering organizations * Ability to define and operationalize company\-wide measurement frameworks for complex, cross\-cutting strategic metrics tied to executive goals with rigor in methodology and clarity in communication * Proven portfolio management: strong say\-do ratio across quarterly planning while balancing feature work, tech refresh, and run\-the\-business commitments Comfortable owning the full product arc: strategy Alpha Beta GA deprecation* successor roadmap **Staff\-Level Leadership** * **Builder mindset:** demonstrated track record of going beyond the PM role — prototyping tools, contributing to innersource repositories, or personally shipping solutions to real developer friction * Operates with systems thinking across interconnected platform domains — seeing how changes in one area create leverage or risk in others * Strong cross\-org influence without authority: proven ability to align engineers, architects, and VPs around a shared platform vision * Exceptional communicator across formats: design critiques, executive roadmap reviews, external blog posts, developer community talks * Deep empathy for the developer experience — you understand what slows developers down across the full PDLC, and you have the conviction and relationships to fix it at the platform level **What Success Looks Like** * **In 6 months:** You've shipped a platform capability that demonstrably reduces developer toil, defined a measurement framework leaders use to make real decisions, and contributed a tool or skill the broader community builds on. * **In 12 months:** You've shaped multi\-year strategy for your focus area, driven measurable progress toward 3x Developer Velocity targets — reduced lead time to production, increased self\-serve provisioning to near 100%, reduced time\-to\-insight from ODL from days to minutes — and influenced the platform philosophy of PDX beyond your direct ownership. * **At the staff level:** You are the PM other PMs come to jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** In this role, you will report to the Electrical Engineering Manager and serve as a principal technical and project lead for development of electromechanical chassis systems, including steering and driveline products. This position requires a strong understanding of overall software and hardware development processes, practical experience with embedded systems and test environments, and the ability to provide hands\-on technical support when needed. This is a principal role for an engineer who can align project goals, technical tasks, and development resources while also contributing directly to problem solving, testing, and system integration. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead complex engineering programs by defining project objectives, managing risks and resources, and coordinating cross\-functional teams to achieve customer and business goals. * Serve as the technical authority for software, electronic hardware, system integration, and control system development, providing guidance on architecture, requirements, technical reviews, and issue resolution. * Lead technical reviews of requirements, specifications, interfaces, drawings, validation plans, and test results, providing recommendations to improve product performance, quality, manufacturability, and development efficiency. * Define and lead verification and validation activities, including planning, traceability, test coverage, and the development of calibration, diagnostic, communication, and test tools to support efficient product development and issue resolution. * Support product launch and production by partnering with manufacturing, quality, and supplier management teams to resolve production issues, implement corrective actions, and improve quality, yield, and process robustness. * Lead and contribute to critical technical activities across product development, integration, validation, and production support, providing hands\-on expertise in problem solving, technical reviews, and issue resolution when required. * Work additional hours, including weekends, when directed by the immediate supervisor or when necessary to complete essential job duties. * Develop and maintain responsive, cooperative relationships with internal and external customers while treating others with dignity, trust, and respect. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but includes project leadership, technical leadership, mentoring, and coordination of cross\-functional engineering activities. **Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Strong understanding of electromechanical systems, embedded controls, electrical architectures, vehicle networks, diagnostics, and system integration. * Strong understanding of automotive software and hardware development processes, including requirements management, model\-based development, verification and validation, configuration management, and V\-cycle development. * Ability to apply control theory, system modeling, signal analysis, and closed\-loop control principles to system design, performance evaluation, and problem solving. * Working knowledge of HIL, dynamometer, laboratory, and vehicle test environments, including system integration, instrumentation, test automation, and data acquisition. * Working knowledge of automotive communication protocols and development tools, including CAN/CAN FD, diagnostics, calibration, and measurement systems. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. **Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Optical * Supplementary Insurance * Optional Benefits (pet insurance, legal consultation, cyber security, retirement support, mental health services, etc.) * 401K (With match) * HSA contribution * Success Sharing * Paid Time\-Off * Educational Reimbursement **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline required; Master's degree preferred. * Minimum 10 years of experience developing automotive electromechanical systems, preferably steering, braking, chassis, driveline, or other safety\-critical products. * Experience leading complex product development programs from concept through production launch and field support. * Experience with engineering risk assessment and structured problem\-solving methodologies, including FMEA, FTA, 8D, and root\-cause investigation. * Experience using automotive development and validation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape, HIL platforms, calibration tools, and data acquisition systems. * Experience supporting product launch and manufacturing operations, including troubleshooting production issues and implementing corrective actions. * Experience with functional safety and automotive development processes, including ISO 26262, ASPICE, CMMI, or equivalent methodologies, preferred. * Experience applying automation, data analytics, machine learning, or AI\-based tools to improve engineering productivity, testing efficiency, or decision\-making is a plus. **Work Environment:** * Work is mostly performed in a normal office setting with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards, and with substantial time spent working on a computer. * Performing this position may occasionally require exposure to manufacturing areas which require the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses with side shields and mandatory hearing protection. * Travel by automobile and plane required approximately 5\-10% of time.

jobs.title: Civil Engineer PE
jobs.description: Description: At Jackola Engineering \& Architecture, we believe successful projects are built through strong relationships, thoughtful design, and talented people. We're looking for an experienced Civil Engineer with a Professional Engineer (PE) license to join our Kalispell team and help shape communities through a wide variety of land development and infrastructure projects. As part of our collaborative, full\-service design team, you'll work alongside engineers, surveyors, architects, planners, and designers to deliver practical, high\-quality solutions for both public and private sector clients. From subdivisions and stormwater systems to water infrastructure, site grading, erosion control, and roadway improvements, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that make a lasting impact on the communities we serve. We're seeking a motivated professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, mentoring others, and working closely with clients, agencies, and project teams. jobs.title: Mill Quality Assurance and Compliance Engineer
jobs.description: #### **JOB TITLE: Mill Quality Assurance and Compliance Engineer** **DEPARTMENT: Mill Technical** **LOCATION: Robinson Nevada Mining Company \- Ruth, NV** **POSITION REPORTS TO: Chief Metallurgical Engineer** **ROTATING SHIFT: No** **EXEMPT** #### **Purpose \& Scope of The Position:** The Mill Quality Assurance and Compliance Engineer supports copper mine and mill operations by providing accurate, timely analytical data and technical laboratory support. This role is responsible for QA/QC reporting, analytical method development, preparation and maintenance of standard operating procedures (SOPs), data review and interpretation, and support of laboratory systems and projects. The position works closely with operations, metallurgy, and assay laboratory teams to ensure reliable analytical performance, sound quality practices, and safe laboratory operations. #### **Job Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Prepare and issue QA/QC reports and monitor laboratory quality indicators, including standards, blanks, duplicates, and control data. * Develop, validate, optimize, and document analytical methods for wet chemistry and instrumental analysis in support of mine, mill, and assay laboratory needs. * Write, revise, and maintain laboratory SOPs and manage the laboratory SOP system to ensure current, controlled, and accessible procedures. * Create, prepare, qualify, and maintain analytical standards, reagents, and reference materials used in routine and special testing. * Review analytical data for accuracy, precision, completeness, and compliance with established quality requirements. * Interpret and communicate results from wet chemistry and instrumental analyses to support operational, metallurgical, and quality decisions. * Operate, troubleshoot, calibrate, and support maintenance of laboratory instruments and equipment. * Maintain accurate records in LIMS and other laboratory data systems and support data integrity and traceability. * Use statistical tools to trend performance, investigate out\-of\-control conditions, and support continuous improvement. * Support mill reagent tracking, assay laboratory chemical inventory, and laboratory project work as needed. * Work safely and in compliance with site, environmental, and laboratory safety requirements * Support mill reagent monitoring and related laboratory coordination activities. * Maintain assay lab chemical inventory and assist with ordering, stocking, and safe storage of chemicals and consumables. * Provide project support, special testing, and technical assistance as needed. * Perform additional duties as needed to support the success of Robinson Nevada Mining Company and KGHM. #### #### **Required Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical or Process Engineering, or a closely related chemical or engineer science discipline. * **Experience:** + Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, QA/QC practices, and laboratory documentation requirements. + Experience reviewing analytical data, identifying anomalies, and interpreting results from both wet chemistry and instrumental methods. + Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). + Working knowledge of statistics as applied to laboratory data evaluation, trending, and quality control. + Ability to write clear technical procedures, maintain controlled documents, and communicate findings effectively. * **Licenses:** Valid driver’s license. #### #### **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Experience:** + Experience working in a mine site, concentrator, assay lab, or metallurgical laboratory environment. + Hands\-on experience supporting production laboratories with fast turnaround analytical requirements. + Familiarity with jobs.title: Senior Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Lead the Way to Intelligent Banking with Us!** You might not think about what happens behind the scenes when you check your bank balance or deposit a check from your phone, but we do. Every day. Kinective empowers banks and credit unions to move beyond keeping up with technology to shaping the future of banking. Our platform seamlessly connects the right tools, delivers real\-time data, and drives smarter operations for more than 4,000 financial institutions nationwide. We are a fast\-growing team built on individual ownership, company\-wide collaboration, and setting industry\-leading standards. Here, new ideas are encouraged, candid feedback is welcomed, and your growth truly matters as much as the company’s. At Kinective, we are leading the way to intelligent banking together and enjoying the journey along the way. **Why This Role Matters** Every role at Kinective exists to move the needle for our clients, partners, and the financial institutions we serve. We are looking for a Senior Cloud Network Engineer at Kinective to own and evolve the networking backbone that powers our products and connects us to our customers. This is a product\-facing role — not internal IT. You will design, build, and operate the cloud and customer\-facing network infrastructure that directly impacts product reliability, security posture, and compliance standing. You will work primarily across AWS with supporting Azure environments, manage VPN tunnel infrastructure for client connectivity, and play an active role in SOC 2 and PCI DSS audit readiness and evidence collection. This role requires someone who thinks in systems, communicates clearly across engineering, security, and customer teams, and takes ownership end\-to\-end. Everything we build is delivered as code — no click\-ops in production. What you’ll own Cloud \& Product Networking * Design and operate network architectures across AWS (primary) and Azure, including VPCs, VNets, and Transit Gateways * Enforce strict network segmentation between production and non\-production environments — separate VPCs/VNets, distinct routing domains, and explicit deny\-by\-default posture * Manage routing, peering, and segmentation across multi\-cloud environments to support product SLAs and security boundaries * Maintain and optimize network performance, availability, and observability across cloud regions * Collaborate with platform and infrastructure engineering teams to integrate networking into CI/CD pipelines and IaC workflows Client VPN \& Secure Connectivity * Design, provision, and maintain IPsec and SSL/TLS VPN tunnels connecting product environments to enterprise clients * Own the full lifecycle of client tunnel onboarding — from technical scoping through cutover and steady\-state support * Serve as the primary technical point of contact during client network onboarding and connectivity incidents; lead customer\-facing troubleshooting calls and produce written RCAs when client connectivity is impaired * Troubleshoot and resolve tunnel stability, latency, and routing issues in coordination with client network teams — including packet capture and side\-by\-side config review * Maintain documentation for all client connectivity configurations, including IP schemas, tunnel parameters, and escalation paths Security \& Compliance * Support SOC 2 (Type II) and PCI DSS audit cycles — collecting network evidence, remediating findings, and responding to auditor requests * Implement and enforce network controls aligned to SOC 2 Common Criteria and PCI DSS network segmentation and firewall requirements * Conduct periodic firewall rule reviews, NACLs/security group audits, and access control assessments * Collaborate with the security team on threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and incident response for network\-layer events * Maintain network diagrams and data flow documentation required for compliance scoping Operations \& Engineering Excellence * All network infrastructure changes are delivered as code — no console changes in production. Author and maintain reusable OpenTofu / Terraform modules for VPCs, VNets, TGW attachments, VPN tunnels, firewall rules, and routing policy. Every change lands via peer\-reviewed PR * Track work, changes, and incidents in JIRA; contribute to clear ticket hygiene and change\-management workflows * Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and runbooks for network health across environments * Participate in on\-call rotation for network\-layer incidents; lead post\-incident reviews for network events * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to architectural decisions and standards Requirements: **Necessary Qualifications \& Competencies** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience in cloud\-native or hybrid environments * Deep expertise with AWS networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53, Security Groups, NACLs, Network Firewall) * Cloud security \& connectivity — hands\-on with AWS IAM (roles, policies, identity federation), SSM (Systems Manager, Session Manager, Parameter Store), GuardDuty, and Security Hub * Working knowledge of Azure networking (VNet, Azure Firewall, NSGs) — we recognize deep expertise in both clouds is rare; strong AWS with willingness to grow in Azure (or vice versa) is acceptable * Proven experience designing and operating IPsec/IKEv2 and SSL VPN tunnels with enterprise clients * Solid understanding of BGP, OSPF, and routing policy in multi\-cloud and hybrid contexts * Hands\-on experience with compliance programs — SOC 2 and/or PCI DSS — specifically network controls and audit evidence * Experience authoring reusable OpenTofu or Terraform modules, not just consuming them * Strong TCP/IP fundamentals: subnetting, DNS, TLS, NAT, load balancing * Hands\-on packet\-level troubleshooting — Wireshark, tcpdump, mtr, iperf, dig * Proficiency with AWS CLI, Azure CLI, Python, Bash/PowerShell, and Docker for automation, tooling, and troubleshooting * Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable running technical calls with customer network engineers **Preferred Skills** * Working understanding of modern AI tooling and hands\-on experience with coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate module authoring, troubleshooting, and documentation * Experience with network observability tooling (e.g., VPC Flow Logs, Azure NSG Flow Logs, Datadog, Grafana, Dynatrace) * Familiarity with Nagios or similar network monitoring platforms * Familiarity with zero trust network architecture (ZTNA) principles and implementation * Familiarity with Cisco Meraki and IPS/IDS platforms * DDoS protection and WAF experience — AWS Shield/WAF or Azure Front Door/WAF * Hybrid DNS design across Route 53, Azure Private DNS, and on\-prem resolvers * Exposure to Kubernetes networking (CNI, ingress controllers, service mesh) in multi\-cloud deployments * Financial\-services or regulated\-industry background * Relevant certifications: AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, Azure Network Engineer Associate, CCNP, or equivalent * Experience working within a CI/CD\-driven infrastructure model (Harness, GitHub Actions, or similar) **Pay, Benefits \& Total Rewards** **$160,000–$180,000 with 10% bonus potential** The salary range listed reflects the minimum and maximum for this role. Individual compensation is based on experience, qualifications, job\-related skills, location, and internal equity, and most offers are not made at the top of the range. Base pay is one part of Kinective’s Total Rewards package. Depending on the role, employees may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. All employees have access to a competitive benefits package designed to support health, well\-being, and financial security, including: * Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, prescriptions, life \& disability) * Flexible PTO, 11 company holidays, and generous parental and caregiver leave * An immediately vested 401(k) with company contributions * Wellness resources and professional development opportunities If you’ve made it this far, we’d love to hear from you. Click Apply to start the conversation, even if you’re not sure you check every box. Learn more about Kinective at www.kinective.io. **Please note that this role does not currently offer sponsorship opportunities. Open to Colorado residents only.**

jobs.title: Senior Architect
jobs.description: **About Knightscope** Knightscope (NASDAQ: KSCP) is a security technology company building the nation's first Autonomous Security Force — autonomous machines, AI\-driven software, and elite security professionals operating as one integrated managed service. The Company is on a mission to make the United States of America the safest country in the world. One Team. One Force. **Job Summary** Knightscope is looking for a Sr. Architect to lead the design of our AI\-native Signals platform, the real\-time data and intelligence layer that ingests, fuses, and acts on signals from our autonomous machines, sensors, and security operations. This is a hands\-on architecture role responsible for setting the technical direction for a platform that must scale from edge device to cloud with low\-latency, high\-reliability requirements. **About the Role** As Sr. Architect for the Signals platform, you will own the end\-to\-end architecture for how Knightscope's autonomous machines and security devices generate, transmit, process, and surface actionable signals. You'll partner closely with hardware, robotics, ML, and product teams to define data contracts, streaming and event\-driven architecture, and the AI/ML pipelines that turn raw sensor data into real\-time alerts and insights for customers and operators. You will set engineering standards, mentor senior engineers, and make build\-vs\-buy and platform investment decisions that shape the future of autonomous security. **Key Responsibilities** * Define and own the technical architecture for Knightscope's AI\-native Signals platform, from edge sensor/device ingestion through cloud processing and customer\-facing delivery. * Design real\-time, event\-driven, and streaming data pipelines capable of fusing signals from autonomous machines, robots, and IoT devices at scale. * Architect the AI/ML infrastructure and model\-serving layer that turns raw signal data into actionable alerts, insights, and automated responses. * Set platform\-wide standards for data contracts, APIs, observability, security, and reliability across engineering jobs.title: UI Design Associate
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. **The Role** **Your role** As a User Interface Designer, you will shape how people experience digital products by designing clear, intuitive, and visually cohesive interfaces. You will focus on how users move through screens and how visual and interactive elements support that movement. Your work will translate product intent and user needs into tangible interface designs that are usable, accessible, and consistent across platforms. You will balance independent design execution with close collaboration across design and delivery teams to bring interfaces from concept through implementation. **What you will do** * Design end to end user interfaces for digital products, including screens, layouts, components, and interaction states * Create visual and interactive elements that guide users clearly through workflows and tasks * Apply design systems, patterns, and standards to ensure consistency across products and platforms * Translate requirements and user insights into wireframes, high fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes * Collaborate with UX designers, researchers, engineers, and product partners to align interface design with user needs and technical constraints * Review implemented designs to ensure visual and interaction fidelity to approved designs * Iterate designs based on usability findings, feedback, and evolving product requirements **Who You Are** **Required skills and experience** * Experience designing user interfaces for web or digital applications * Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, layout, typography, color, and interaction design * Ability to design at the skeleton and surface levels of the experience * Proficiency with industry standard design and prototyping tools * Experience applying and contributing to design systems and component libraries * Ability to translate requirements into clear, production ready interface designs * Experience collaborating with cross functional teams in a product or delivery environment **Preferred skills and experience** * Experience designing for accessibility and inclusive design standards * Familiarity with usability testing and incorporating findings into interface design * Experience working closely with front end engineers during implementation * Exposure to enterprise or complex digital products The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $63,360 to $114,120based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area):$76,080 to $137,040 California (All Other):$69,720 to $125,640 Colorado: $63,360 to $114,120 Massachusetts$63,360 to $125,640 New York City: $76,080 to $137,040 Washington: $69,720 to $125,640 Washington DC:$69,720 to $125,640 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Being You** The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Co-op (Applications) (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: Onsite: Boston, MA Headquarters Build the applications layer that turns sensor data into real insights utilities use to manage the power grid. The successful **Full Stack Software Engineering (Applications) Co\-op** will help develop our cloud\-hosted and on\-prem products that turn real\-time sensor data into actionable insights for utilities. You’ll work across the stack, from Python data pipelines to React/TypeScript web apps, all while contributing to a product that’s reshaping how the electric grid is monitored and managed. Join our collaborative Applications (LineRate) team at **LineVision**, named of the Built In Best Places to Work in Boston for three years running. **What will you do?** --------------------- **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives** * Design, build, test and maintain software applications and internal tools to support data health and application administration * Integrate with internal and external APIs, cloud services, and relational databases * Contribute to new system design and proof\-of\-concept exploration * Become a valued member of a high\-performing software engineering team by supporting team goals of continuous improvement and our culture of growth\-mindset **What do you need to succeed in this role?** --------------------------------------------- * Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related degree * Understanding of object\-oriented and functional design principles, relational databases, distributed software design, and Agile methodologies for team software development * Strong and disciplined approach to test\-driven software development * Initiative, creative problem\-solving skills and team collaboration * Desired experience and programming languages: + Javascript \& Python (required); Typescript/SQL/React/Node (preferred) + Experience working on web application front ends \+ RESTful API backends + Cloud infrastructure; AWS (preferred), Azure and/or Google Cloud + (Optionally) Math and science Python libraries like Pandas or NumPy **Work Schedule** ----------------- The ideal candidate would be available from **January 19\-August 27 2027**, working 40 hours a week. All co\-ops will work from LineVision’s Charlestown, MA headquarters 2\-4 days per week, with specific schedules determined in collaboration with your direct manager. LineVision has a standard US holiday schedule, and up to a week of additional unpaid time off is permissible. Upon successful internship or co\-op completion, you will be considered for a full\-time position upon graduation. Compensation: $25 per hour **What does joining LineVision mean for you?** ---------------------------------------------- * **Impact.** Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power. * **Ownership.** You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment. * **Flexibility.** You will be empowered to maintain work\-life balance with a flexible hybrid work schedule. * **Real World Innovation.** You will join a motivated and high\-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an AI\-powered future. **Who we are…** --------------- LineVision is a grid\-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network\-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. We are LineVisionaries: * **We are Innovators:** We light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work. * **We are Empowered:** With high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours. * **We are Welcoming**: Come as you are, our doors are open. We are better together. * **We are Trusted Partners:** We elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. We deliver on commitments. * **We are All In**: We are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe. At LineVision there’s no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. We are looking for exceptional people who want to make a positive impact through their work and facilitate an organization where everyone can thrive. So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day. *LineVision embraces AI, and we understand leveraging AI in your job search. As an actual member of LineVision's hiring team reviews every application, we kindly ask that any final materials you submit reflect your own voice and authentic human experience.* Meet our team, understand our mission: https://www.linevisioninc.com/about\-us \#LI\-DNI

The structure of our organization is designed to amplify your capabilities while gaining the benefits of being an employee\-owner. What truly sets this opportunity apart is the chance to collaborate every day with dedicated, skilled, and supportive leaders. Whether you are in the office, in the field, or behind the scenes, working at LJA gives you the chance to grow through hands\-on experience and exposure to a broad range of clients and services. **WHAT MAKES LJA DIFFERENT** At LJA, our employee\-owners take pride in their work and their workplace. We’re guided by leaders who foster a culture of respect, collaboration and a shared vision of success. Our difference is evident in the experiences and opportunities we provide: * Employee\-owned. Client\-focused * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * Consistently ranked as a ***Top Workplace*** * Internal recruitment team, in\-house training, and a marketing department specific to our industry * We celebrate flexibility, allowing every team and office to lead with their proven approach * Our culture champions continuous learning and personal growth * We believe success comes through constant evolution and communication * We are passionate about having fun and making money, all while creating impact **POSITION OVERVIEW:** As a **Design Engineer** at LJA **Land Development**, you will use AutoCAD Civil3D, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office and other design and production software to provide design, production, and project administrative support in the delivery of feasibilities, opinions of probable cost, studies, exhibits, construction plans, takeoffs, bid packages, models, and development support tasks for an extensive list of public and private clients. Our exciting and entrepreneurial culture will allow you to think creatively, solve problems and meet the needs of our clients daily. **A TYPICAL DAY MIGHT INCLUDE:** * Collaborate with technical experts, peers, and support roles to perform design calculations, prepare equipment or material specifications, and generate technical drawings and exhibits * Expanding your engineering toolbox and vocabulary to add knowledge of advanced techniques, applied theory, industry concepts, and best practices. * Assignments require the investigation of a limited number of variables; supervisory assistance is provided on unusual problems and possible solutions. * Working in an office equipped with meeting rooms, amenities, and excellent technology. * Investigating existing site conditions, jurisdictional criteria, and constraints to inform design iterations and direction. * Check\-ins with your manager and other engineering mentors to identify areas of excellence and growth opportunities. * Providing information or exhibits to inform client and internal leaders in decision making related to the execution or implementation of project objectives. **REQUIRED EDUCATION/LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor of Science Degree from ABET accredited university (Civil Engineering Preferred) **IDEALLY, YOU SHOULD ALSO HAVE:** * Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D * Previous work experience in the engineering industry * Experience with Bluebeam and Water Resources Software (HEC\-RAS \& HEC\-HMS) * Passed the FE Exam * Strong communication skills * Team Mentality **LEVEL UP WITH LJA** At LJA, we’re 100% employee\-owned. This drives results, rewards ambition and supports long\-term success for every team member. With almost 100 locations and 3,000\+ employee\-owners (and growing), we’re building something big! We want you to be part of it. Your future grows here. * **Generous Time Off:** PTO, paid holidays, and a full office closure between Christmas and New Year’s. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Multiple plan options for health, dental, and pets. Along with mental health support. * **Family Support:** Paid maternity and parental leave to help you focus on what matters most. * **Education Support:** Tuition reimbursement and in\-house courses provided by our Learning and Development team. * **Referral Bonuses:** Know great talent? Get rewarded for helping us grow. * **Community Impact:** Company\-sponsored volunteer days and philanthropic initiatives. * **Professional Development:** Memberships to industry organizations to keep you connected and growing. * **Career Growth:** Great internal mobility opportunities to advance your career. * **Fun Culture:** LJA social events, employee sports teams, bring your kid to work day, etc. To Executive Search Firms \& Staffing Agencies: LJA, Inc. and its subsidiaries do not accept unsolicited resumes from any agencies that have not signed a service agreement. All unsolicited resumes will be considered LJA's property. This includes resumes submitted directly to hiring managers without contacting LJA's Human Resources Talent Department. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: GTM Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Lantern** Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Lantern is seeking a GTM Solutions Engineer — a forward\-deployed technical specialist embedded within the Growth Marketing function and serving as the primary systems owner for the entire Growth Marketing tech stack. This role owns the how: architecting integrations, deploying AI\-powered and agentic automation, and ensuring Lantern's marketing technology stack is scalable, measurable, and continuously improving. The ideal candidate is a lead management expert who operates with a high degree of autonomy, brings hands\-on AI maturity, and understands the Growth Marketing function as deeply as the tools that support it. They know when to apply AI and when traditional integrated solutions are the right answer \- and can defend that judgment to leadership with data and conviction. **Location:** Hybrid \- at least 3 days/week in our New York City office **Your Mission** Reporting to the Sr. Director, GTM Systems and embedded within Growth Marketing, you will: * Act as an embedded technical owner for the Growth Marketing tech stack \- partnering directly with Growth Marketing leadership to translate business needs into working solutions, leading every stage from requirements gathering and solution design through build, testing, and deployment with a high degree of autonomy. * Own, operate, and continuously improve the full Growth Marketing tech stack: HubSpot, Outreach, Nooks, ZoomInfo, Clay, and Salesforce – identify gaps and help shape where the stack goes from here. * Design and implement lead management workflows end\-to\-end: from initial intake and campaign execution through outbound engagement and conversion tracking, ensuring every handoff is instrumented and every outcome is measurable. * Build and deploy agentic and AI\-powered solutions that eliminate manual process across top\-of\-funnel workflows \- knowing when AI is the right answer and when a traditional integration is faster and more reliable. * Pilot new tools with rigor: develop a structured point of view on trade\-offs and ROI, document your findings, and present clear build\-vs.\-buy recommendations to leadership. * Maintain a prioritized, visible systems roadmap \- communicating what is in progress, what is next, and why, in a format that earns the trust of non\-technical stakeholders. * Articulate system and workflow designs in Lucid or comparable diagramming tools, and explain those designs to non\-technical marketing leaders in a way that is compelling and builds confidence. * Collaborate with the Salesforce Admin team and Salesforce Architect on CRM\-side implementations \- and bring hands\-on Salesforce Flows experience (and Apex/SQL where needed) to accelerate delivery without waiting on others. * Be relentlessly organized: plan, test, and measure every solution with documented baselines and outcomes \- so the team always knows what changed and whether it worked. **What You Will Bring** * A minimum of 5 years owning or deeply administering a B2B growth marketing tech stack (CRM, sales engagement, data enrichment, \& marketing automation tools). * Hands\-on production experience with Clay. * Demonstrated, shipped AI and agentic automation experience applied to GTM or revenue operations workflows \- with a clear, defensible point of view on when AI is and isn't the right answer. * Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously across the full project lifecycle. * First\-hand lead management experience \- supporting lead intake, campaigns, outbound sales engagement, and tracking leads through to conversion. * Proven ability to instrument lead tracking end\-to\-end and surface actionable conversion analytics to team managers \- with an understanding of what it takes to build and sustain lead data quality across integrated systems. * Ability to translate business requirements into measurable technical outcomes \- and communicate system designs clearly and compellingly to non\-technical marketing leadership. * Proven ability to pilot new tools, develop structured trade\-off analyses and ROI assessments, and present clear build\-vs.\-buy recommendations to leadership. * Experience maintaining a prioritized, visible systems roadmap that keeps stakeholders informed and initiatives properly scoped before work begins. **Preferred Skills:** * Salesforce experience building moderately complex Flows in a production environment and familiarity with Apex and/or SQL for custom logic is strongly preferred * Hands\-on experience with HubSpot, Outreach and ZoomInfo are nice to have. * Experience with Nooks or comparable AI\-powered sales engagement platforms are nice to have. **Benefits** * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Life Insurance * 401k with company match * Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave Compensation $165,000\-$200,000 \+ annual bonus (depends on location/level/relevant experience) **About You:** * You use **LOGIC** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast\-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small \& big wins. * **INCLUSION** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives \& you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with. * You have the **GRIT**, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas. * You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep **HUMANITY** in all decisions. Your customers aren't just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change. * Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the **TRUTH** vs. giving people the answers they want to hear. * You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change. These pillars of **LIGHT** are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this **LIGHT**, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern. Please apply to our role \& someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process. Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Berkeley Lab’s Center for Advanced Mathematics for Energy Research Applications (CAMERA) has a new opening for a postdoctoral scholar to develop cutting\-edge mathematics and algorithms to analyze complex data from Department of Energy (DOE) experimental facilities. This role involves research and development spanning areas such as optimization, Fourier analysis, numerical linear algebra, statistics, machine learning, and high\-performance computing for one or more of the following: (1\) reconstruction of 3D\+ structure, heterogeneity, and/or dynamics from scattering and/or microscopy data; (2\) autonomous analysis and decision making for self\-driving and/or human\-in\-the\-loop experiments; (3\) computer vision for extracting complex patterns, structure, and meaning from images and/or volumes; and (4\) new mathematics and algorithms leading to new applications of machine learning and artificial intelligence to analysis of experimental data. Of particular interest will be new approaches for tackling multimodal data, quantifying uncertainty, providing rigorous theoretical guarantees, and modelling complex physics, noise processes, and measurement error. You will work closely with mathematicians, software engineers, physicists, materials scientists, and beamline scientists to implement these new tools on HPC computer architectures and deliver them as user\-friendly software to meet DOE experimental facility needs. **We’re here for the same mission, to bring science solutions to the world. Join our team and YOU will play a supporting role in our goal to address global challenges! Have a high level of impact and work for an organization associated with 17 Nobel Prizes!** ***Why join Berkeley Lab?*** We invest in our employees by offering a total rewards package you can count on: * Exceptional health and retirement benefits, including pension or 401K\-style plans * A culture where you’ll belong \- we are invested in our teams! * In addition to accruing vacation and sick time, we also have a Winter Holiday Shutdown every year. * Parental bonding leave (for both mothers and fathers) **You will:** * Conduct independent and collaborative research to develop new mathematics and algorithms for analyzing complex data from DOE experimental facilities. * Develop new mathematical algorithms targeting one or more focus areas: (1\) 3D\+ reconstruction of structure/heterogeneity/dynamics from scattering and/or microscopy data; (2\) autonomous analysis and decision\-making for self\-driving and/or human\-in\-the\-loop experiments; (3\) computer vision for extracting patterns, structure, and meaning from images and/or volumes; and (4\) new mathematics and algorithms that enable new reliable new applications of machine learning and artificial intelligence to experimental data analysis. * Make advances in one or more of: multimodal data fusion/joint inference; uncertainty quantification with realistic noise/measurement error; complex physics\- and artifact\-aware forward modeling; and theory\-grounded guarantees for proposed algorithms. * Collaborate with scientific users and experimentalists at DOE experimental facilities to apply the developed software to real datasets and meet their scientific needs. * Publish results in peer\-reviewed venues, present at conferences/workshops, and contribute to CAMERA’s collaborative research activities. **We are looking for:** * Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or related field. * Strong research track record developing advanced mathematical and computational methods for analyzing complex experimental or imaging data. * Demonstrated expertise in several of the following areas: inverse problems, statistics, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and/or computer vision/machine learning. * Strong foundation in at least one of: numerical linear algebra, Fourier/spectral methods, scientific computing, and/or high\-performance computing. * Proven ability to publish in peer\-reviewed venues and present research at seminars, workshops, and scientific conferences. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to contribute effectively to large, collaborative, multidisciplinary projects in a diverse environment. **Desired skills/knowledge:** * Familiarity with modern machine learning methods and software, including experience applying them to scientific or experimental datasets. * Experience collaborating with domain scientists to analyze real experimental data and translate scientific questions into robust, actionable computational approaches. **Additional information:** * Applications will be accepted until the job posting is removed. * **Appointment type:** This is a full\-time, 2 year, postdoctoral appointment with the possibility of renewal based upon satisfactory job performance, continuing availability of funds and ongoing operational needs. You must have less than 3 years of paid postdoctoral experience. Salary for Postdoctoral positions depends on years of experience post\-degree. * **Salary range:** The salary range for this position is $8,570 \- $9,935 and is expected to start at $8,570 or above. Postdoctoral positions are paid on a step schedule per union contract and salaries will be predetermined based on postdoctoral step rates. Each step represents one full year of completed post\-Ph.D. postdoctoral experience. * **Background check:** This position is subject to a background check. Any convictions will be evaluated to determine if they directly relate to the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Having a conviction history will not automatically disqualify an applicant from being considered for employment. * **Work modality:** Work may be performed on\-site, hybrid. The primary location for this role is Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, 1 Cyclotron Road, Berkeley, CA. Work must be performed within the United States. * **Union Represented:** **This position is represented by a union for collective bargaining purposes.** **Want to learn more about working at Berkeley Lab? Please visit:** **careers.lbl.gov** Equal Employment Opportunity Employer: The foundation of Berkeley Lab is our Stewardship Values: Team Science, Service, Trust, Innovation, and Respect; and we strive to build community with these shared values and commitments. Berkeley Lab is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We heartily welcome applications from all who could contribute to the Lab's mission of leading scientific discovery, excellence, and professionalism. In support of our rich global community, all qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected categories under State and Federal law. Misconduct Disclosure Requirement: As a condition of employment, the finalist will be required to disclose if they are subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct, are currently being investigated for misconduct, left a position during an investigation for alleged misconduct, or have filed an appeal with a previous employer.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About LegalZoom** LegalZoom is on a mission to help people navigate the legal system with confidence and clarity. As a leader in online legal services for over 25 years, we combine technology, attorney\-led solutions, and expertise to protect the aspirations, lives, and legacies of millions of customers. If you’re ready to contribute to a collaborative, diverse, and distributed group of creative thinkers and problem\-solvers, we can’t wait to meet you. This hybrid position will work remotely as well as onsite in our Mountain View, Sherman Oaks, or Austin offices. **Human\-in\-the\-Loop** At LegalZoom, we operate with a **human\-in\-the\-loop model**, where AI enhances—rather than replaces—human judgment. We believe the strongest outcomes for our customers come from thoughtfully integrating human expertise with AI capabilities to improve accuracy, safety, and decision\-making. To align with our AI\-integrated operating model, our interview process will assess AI fluency, curiosity, and measurable/impactful workflow integration.**Overview** We’re seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join our growing Data Engineering team. In this role, you will architect, build, and scale robust data pipelines and platforms that power LegalZoom’s products and analytics. You’ll collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners in Data Science, Engineering, and Product to deliver high\-impact solutions, mentor others on the data team, and drive technical excellence across the organization. **You will*** Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and well\-tested data pipelines and ETL processes using dbt, Snowflake, Airflow, and Fivetran. * Architect net new data models to support business needs, ensuring high availability, performance, and extensibility. * Lead the adoption and integration of modern data engineering best practices, including CI/CD, data quality, and observability. * Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, guide technical decisions, and deliver data solutions that align with business goals. * Mentor and guide other data engineers and data scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. * Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical decision\-making. * Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, advocating for best practices. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to address high priority incidents. * Occasional travel may be required as needed. **You have*** 7\+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field, with a proven track record of building and maintaining complex data systems at scale. * Expert\-level proficiency in SQL, with deep experience in data modeling and transformation. * Hands\-on experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling. * Experience orchestrating data workflows using Airflow. * Experience building and maintaining data pipelines with Fivetran, including custom connector development. * Proficiency in Python for data engineering tasks. * Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) and modern data stack tools. * Strong understanding of ETL/ELT best practices, data quality, and data governance. * Ability to architect and deliver highly available, scalable, and extensible solutions. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Experience mentoring and leading engineering teams in an Agile environment. * A strong understanding of business and product goals, and the ability to align your technical decisions to them. * Remote employees should confirm that the internet service available has adequate bandwidth to support all work processes. The salary range for this role is (140,500\-249,700\). Actual compensation offered will depend on several factors including but not limited to: geographic location, work experience, education, skill level, and/or other business and organizational needs. In addition, an annual bonus, incentive bonus and/or restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package. You will also receive a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits as seen below.* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance * 401k, With Matching Contributions * Paid Time Off * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Short\-Term/Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Plus other wellness benefits to include: * Fertility * Mental Health * One Medical **Join us in making a difference as we build our future and help ensure access to professional legal advice to all! LegalZoom is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to diversity, equality, and inclusion, and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. LegalZoom prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.**
