jobs.title: Data Center FCW Submittal Engineer
jobs.description: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. **Where is the work:** Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer supporting the Airside Data Center Fan Coil Wall (TCDC) Pod, you will play a key role in the engineering activities that support sales order processing and execution for one of our important data center product platforms. This role provides the opportunity to lead customer\-focused engineering execution, work closely with cross\-functional teams, and apply advanced engineering judgment from bid support through manufacturing release and field issue resolution. You will contribute to job bidding, submittal generation, BOM development, model generation, mechanical design execution, production support, and field support. This position offers broad exposure across the order execution lifecycle and the opportunity to influence product quality, performance, responsiveness, manufacturability, and continuous improvement through practical engineering solutions, technical leadership, and ongoing design enhancements." **What you will do:** * Lead mechanical engineering activities for the Airside Data Center Fan Coil Wall (TCDC) Pod. * Lead job processing activities, including bid support, submittals, order release, BOM development, and model generation. * Develop and review mechanical design content to support customer\-specific orders and product configurations. * Coordinate with electrical and design resources to ensure complete and accurate engineering deliverables. * Provide technical leadership for production and field activities by resolving mechanical design issues and providing timely technical assistance. * Lead participation in risk assessments, design reviews, and problem\-solving activities to support safe, reliable, and manufacturable designs. * Identify and implement design improvements that enhance product quality, manufacturability, and customer satisfaction. * Partner with manufacturing engineers to incorporate DFM principles into mechanical designs and documentation to improve quality, safety, and assembly efficiency. * Work with lab engineers to ensure customer witness test readiness and support validation of mechanical system performance. * Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions related to quality, reliability, and field issues. * Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, and related product records. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with operations, manufacturing, quality, and product management to support business objectives. * Identify and support year\-over\-year cost and margin improvement initiatives. * Provide technical guidance and engineering support to less experienced engineers and designers as needed. **What you will bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering field is required. * Minimum of 3 years of experience in design engineering, product engineering, or mechanical engineering support is required. * Experience supporting configured\-to\-order or engineered\-to\-order products is preferred. * Ability to travel up to 10% of the time is required. * Strong working knowledge of mechanical systems, product documentation, bills of material, and engineering drawing/model processes. * Ability to work effectively across engineering, design, as appropriate. * Test data movement, transformation code, and data components. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * Bachelor’s Degree in STEM related field or PM21 Requirements: **Required** * BS in Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent * 3\+ years in software and firmware engineering * Exceptional Communication skills · Strong proficiency in C and C\+\+ programming. * Experience developing software for microcontrollers or embedded processors. * Experience developing and maintaining embedded Linux systems. * Experience with Git for source\-code management and collaborative software development. * Proficiency with Visual Studio Code (VS Code) or a comparable integrated development environment. * Solid understanding of embedded systems concepts, including interrupts, timers, memory management, concurrency, and hardware interfaces. * Experience with embedded debugging tools and software development workflows. * Familiarity with software development processes, code reviews, testing methodologies, and configuration management. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to read and understand schematics, datasheets, and hardware specifications. **Desired** * Familiarity with UEFI BIOS and Intel x86 architectures * Familiarity with ARM \& embedded Linux development * Familiarity with PIC microcontroller development and other bare\-metal and low\-level firmware * Experience with the Yocto Project, including recipes, custom layers, BitBake, machine configurations, and image customization. * Experience with RTOS, such as FreeRTOS. * Experience with ARM processors. * Familiarity with Intel architecture. * Strong experience with embedded Linux system development and Linux kernel configuration. * Experience developing device drivers, bootloaders, BSPs, or board\-support software. * Experience with secure boot, firmware updates, cybersecurity, or embedded device security * Knowledge of FIPS\-140\-2, TPM, Bitlocker, STIG, and/or other security technologies * Scripting experience – bash, Zsh, Powershell, Python

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Labeling Engineer – BarTender Software
jobs.description: Job Title: Pharmaceutical Labeling Engineer – BarTender Software Job Function: Compliance SME Location: SANTA MONICA, CA \- Hybrid **About USDM** USDM Life Sciences is a premier consulting company with 20\+ years of experience assisting heavily regulated biotech, medical device, and pharmaceutical companies with their GxP technologies to accelerate growth. Our deep domain knowledge and technology expertise in life sciences business processes are what set us apart. From strategy to implementation and adoption, we have delivered thousands of GxP projects globally. As part of the USDM team, you have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies through our many partnerships with companies like Microsoft, Google, Oracle, DocuSign, Box, and many more. From molecule to market, you will help connect technology, people, and data in new ways to generate real\-time insights to improve business outcomes for USDM’s clients. Are you ready to make an impact and drive real digital transformation in life sciences? Founded in Santa Barbara in 1999, USDM has grown to a progressive, global company with 300\+ remote employees and offices throughout the US, Canada, and Germany. **Nature and Scope of Job** Seeking a BSA Label Design \& Implementation Contractor with deep expertise in Bartender label design software and Visual Basic (VB) scripting. The ideal candidate will support end‑to‑end label lifecycle activities—including design, configuration, testing, validation, and deployment—within a GxP\-regulated biopharma, biotech, or cell therapy environment. This role requires strong collaboration with IT, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, and R\&D or QC Lab teams to ensure compliant, reliable, and scalable labeling solutions. On\-site, hybrid in Southern California: Greate LA area (El Segundo, Santa Monica) **Primary Responsibilities** Label Design \& Development * Design, develop, configure, and optimize labels using Bartender, including advanced templates, dynamic data handling, automation, and printing logic. * Utilize Visual Basic scripting to support conditional logic, formatting, and integration with upstream systems. * Implement standardized label formats across systems and sites to support harmonization and reduce deviations. Label Lifecycle Management * Drive the full label lifecycle: requirement gathering, design, configuration, testing, validation, production deployment, and support. * Troubleshoot label\-related issues across interconnected systems (e.g., MES, Robar, ERP/EBS, Bartender). * Maintain documentation, SOP updates, and knowledge transfer materials. Support \& Continuous Improvement * Provide hands\-on support during transitions, system upgrades, and site enablement projects. * Assist with troubleshooting high‑priority incidents and participating in cross\-team triage. * Identify opportunities to improve labeling processes, tooling, and documentation. **Additional Responsibilities** * Performs other related duties and assignments as required **Qualifications** * Expert\-level proficiency with Bartender, including design, automation, and server components. * Strong Visual Basic / VBScript skills applied to label automation and dynamic behavior. * Strong troubleshooting skills in complex labeling ecosystems involving MES, ERP, and printing hardware. * Experience in biotech, pharma, or cell therapy supply chain, with familiarity in materials management, batch/lot control, serialization, and regulated operations. **Education \& Certifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Systems or related field. * Master’s Degree preferred **Working Conditions** The working conditions described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job and are not meant to be all\-inclusive. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - APIs
jobs.description: Unacast is a leading provider of global location intelligence that delivers cutting\-edge analytics about human mobility in the physical world. We are a team of experts with decades of unmatched industry experience and we partner with organizations across the private and public sectors to unlock the potential of location data. Unacast drives smarter decision\-making based on trustworthy, reliable, and privacy\-friendly location intelligence that powers both commercial and societal benefits. We take a customer\-first approach and are building APIs to provide valuable analytics across very large datasets, enlightening our customers to the “needle in a haystack” of big data. Our aim is to be the go\-to leaders in location data, and we are now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our effort. **We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer with API expertise!** The Senior Software Engineer will work as part of Unacast’s API team, assisting in the development of customer\-facing and internal APIs with an emphasis on fast querying of large datasets. The APIs maintained by this team are the core building blocks of our data offering. Successful candidates will demonstrate an ability to translate business problems into technology solutions and products while overseeing the full application life cycle. As a member of the API team, you will work closely with both engineering and product development to deliver creative and effective solutions. This position requires significant prior Java development experience, including the Java Spring Framework. Experience with database management and SQL querying are critical as well as AWS experience. The ideal candidate will be team and customer service oriented, innovative, open\-minded to different solutions, and driven to deliver solutions that meet or exceed requirements. You believe that simple approaches are better than complex. **What You Will Do:** * Collaborate with product development and other teams to translate business initiatives into concrete technical requirements. * Create innovative solutions to support partners and customers by building applications that deliver required functionality while adhering to best practices in development and testing. This includes the development of unit, integration, and runtime tests. * Work with the engineering team on the optimal design and maintenance of the large Snowflake data lake that powers the APIs. This includes database table design and efficient SQL querying to produce short API response times. * Create quality internal and external documentation for your work. Internal documentation is critical during the development and maintenance of a project and comprehensive external documentation is essential for customer onboarding. * Create data, metrics and visualizations, as needed, for complex algorithm verification and optimization. **Capabilities:** * You are both a team player and a self\-starter. You are comfortable working independently with only basic guidance, as well as working well within the larger team. * You have demonstrated experience translating business problems into technology solutions, and deploying the right tool for the job including Scala, Java, third party web services, scripting languages (e.g. Python, R) and third party tool sets. * You are capable of taking a basic description of what is needed, analyzing it and asking the right questions to generate a detailed specification of the software requirements. * You can demonstrate that you have developed multiple applications from requirements elaboration to delivery to production. * You must have great organization skills and strong communication and documentation skills. * You must be able to demonstrate proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools to accelerate code authorship, unit testing, and debugging, while maintaining strict adherence to security protocols and data privacy standards. **Experience:** * 5\+ years’ experience in Java 8 and higher software development with the Java Spring Framework used for REST APIs. * Demonstrate excellent SQL database skills ranging from database initial creation and design, table design, automated load and maintenance processes, and efficient querying. Snowflake SQL is strongly preferred. * Proficiency working in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and utilizing its many services. For example AWS Elastic Container Service for application deployment or AWS X\-Ray for debugging. * Experience processing data efficiently in JSON and GeoJSON. * Proficiency in programming languages such Scala, Python or other similar programming languages. * Demonstrated ability to quickly and efficiently break down larger projects to smaller tasks, and handle multiple projects and tasks at the same time. * Experience in software or engineering projects from ideation, through development and into production. * Proficiency in Agile methodologies. * Strong communication skills and fluency in English. **... and it is a positive if** * Experience with data analytics and data visualization. * You have experience working with geospatial data. **What we expect of you** * Demonstrate a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset. * Contribute to a positive and enjoyable work environment. * We operate like a startup, so things change fast, you need to be agile and proactive. * Participate in the on\-call rotation. * Personal characteristics we value include: high integrity, entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, team player, passion for technology, adaptability, high energy and attention to detail. **Other Info** This is a remote position that may require occasional travel. Candidates must reside in the continental United States with a preference for individuals who live in the EST time zone and/or those residing in the following states: CT, CO, FL, GA, IL, IA, IN, MD, NC, NJ, NM, NY, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WV We offer competitive salaries and benefits and unlimited PTO. The typical base salary range for this role is $125,000 to $145,000\. Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, job level, internal equity and budget. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience and geographic location. Unacast is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, creed, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. Unacast is committed to making the job application process accessible to everyone. If you are living with a disability (visible or not visible), we will provide a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process. To request an accommodation in connection with the application or recruiting process, please contact Human Resources at 703\-840\-8850\. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. Unacast participates in the E\-Verify program.

jobs.description: Unify is building the **first AI\-native outbound platform** where agents and sellers work side by side. We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40\+ sources, and execute personalized, multi\-channel outreach—all from a single AI\-powered workspace. Trusted by some of the most innovative go\-to\-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to **90% time savings** on list building and **19% higher output per rep**. We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast\-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you. **About the role:** ------------------- You will bring new products from zero to one working closely with our founders. We are revolutionizing GTM using all the latest AI technology that has recently come online \- so you will be working at the cutting edge. **What you will do:** --------------------- * Shape both our product roadmap and engineering foundation working with a highly collaborative product, design and engineering team * Build new products using the latest and greatest tech such as such as **TypeScript, Prisma, Temporal, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Pulsar, ClickHouse, LLMs**, and more * Experiment, assess and integrate with various tech platforms and vendors that help us deliver value faster * Lay the foundation for our engineering standard so that we can successfully scale our team and business **Who you are:** ---------------- * **You have 5\+ years of software engineering experience** and have a track record of shipping high\-quality products and features at scale * You are customer\-obsessed, creative and hungry. You have the ability to take high\-level business/product ideas to deployed engineering solutions. * While you are independent you are also kind and highly collaborative. You always go the extra mile to help your team members. * You have experience standing up and managing infrastructure. You are comfortable and excited to mentor multiple engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Unify is building the **first AI\-native outbound platform** where agents and sellers work side by side. We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40\+ sources, and execute personalized, multi\-channel outreach—all from a single AI\-powered workspace. Trusted by some of the most innovative go\-to\-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to **90% time savings** on list building and **19% higher output per rep**. We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast\-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you. **About the Role** ------------------ You'll join a very small, elite product team that works directly with Unify's founders and executive team. You'll own what we build and why. Unify is building the future of go\-to\-market with AI. We have strong product instincts across our engineering and design teams — we're looking for someone to accelerate what we ship, fill gaps in our thinking, and make our product dramatically better for customers. If you've built a product from nothing, run your own company, or been an early PM at a fast\-growing startup — this is your kind of role. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Own the product.** You'll define what we build alongside our founders — with strong opinions rooted in deep customer understanding and business context. **Drive strategy and execution for your pods.** You'll be directly responsible for a couple of growth engineering pods — owning the roadmap, setting priorities, and making sure your teams are shipping the highest\-impact work. **Ship end to end.** Take ideas from napkin sketch to launched feature. You scope it, you ship it, you measure it, you iterate. **Be the voice of the customer.** Talk to users constantly. Dig into usage data. Understand what they're actually trying to do. Turn those insights into product decisions. **Sweat the details on UX.** You care about every click, every label, every flow. You catch the friction that everyone else walks past. You ship things that are simple, elegant, and delightful. **Raise the bar on product quality.** You'll help set the standards for how product works at Unify — how we think about quality, how we make decisions, how we ship. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **5–8 years building product**, ideally at early\-stage or high\-growth B2B/SaaS companies. Bonus if you've founded a company or been an early employee at a startup with Growth experience * **You've shipped 0 1 products.** You know what it's like to build something when there's no playbook. * **Deep product sense and UX instinct.** You have strong taste and a track record of shipping products that users love. * **You move fast and make decisions with imperfect information.** You're comfortable with ambiguity and would rather ship and learn than wait for certainty. * **You're technical enough to be dangerous.** You can read a tech spec, understand system constraints, and have a real conversation with engineers about tradeoffs. * **You're metrics\-driven.** You define success upfront, instrument everything, and let data guide your iterations. You know which numbers matter and you move them. * **Excellent written and verbal communication.** You can articulate a product vision, write a clear spec, and get a room aligned without relying on your title. **Bonus** --------- * You've built AI\-native products, automation tools, or sales/marketing tech. * You've been a founder, co\-founder, or early employee (first \~20\) at a startup. * You've lived in the world of sales, marketing, and revenue tools. You understand how the pipeline actually gets built, why reps hate their CRM, and what "outbound" really looks like day to day. Compensation Range: $230K \- $260K

jobs.title: Manager - Contract Performance
jobs.description: Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network. Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together. **Description** --------------- At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip\-top shape. **Job Overview and Responsibilities** The Manager\-Technical Contract Performance is responsible for driving improved supplier performance by enforcing liquidated damage remedies for late delivery of aircraft parts and managing contract intelligence initiatives. Manager will supervise up to four international direct reports, tasked with identifying, initiating and settling lead time and turnaround time claims, along with tracking, capturing and processing payment of such claims from United's aircraft goods and services suppliers. This position acts as the primary liaison to the Strategic Sourcing department in the development of contract language in support of obtaining such remedies and serves as a subject matter expert in the area of technical contract product support provisions, contract incentives, and the integration of contract intelligence solutions into contract management processes. * Perform and supervise analysis of annual volume of over 120,000 purchase orders and 150,000 repair orders * Identify available remedies from overdue orders * Initiate and settle over 600 claims per year * Manage contract intelligence initiatives supporting contract management processes, including coordination of requirements, implementation activities, and integration of solutions designed to improve contract analysis and accessibility across Tech Ops Supply Chain * Maintain proficiency and currency with Warranty Administration team by supporting a portfolio of claims with vendors * Collaborate and liaise with the Strategic Sourcing team in the drafting of liquidated damages language in new agreements * Support recurrent training of product support provisions contained in all technical contracts **Qualifications** ------------------ #### **What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):** * Bachelor's degree or related experience * Three (3\) years of experience in supply chain, logistics, finance, or similar industry * Proven people leadership * Understanding of material logistics, supply chain management and contract administration * Strong negotiation, communication, analytical and organization skills * Advanced MS Excel * Up to 20% travel * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship * Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification * Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position #### **What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):** * Three (3\) years of experience initiating claims using data extracts, filtering transactions with available knowledge of existing contracts, negotiating settlements with suppliers and processing payments * Experience with contract intelligence tools, or implementation of technology solutions supporting contract management processes * Boeing PSAA and Airbus SSC product support provisions * Able to draft concise product support contract terms * Advanced knowledge of SCEPTRE * Able to write complex SQL queries * Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them for research, analysis, content creation, and problem\-solving. Applies critical thinking to validate AI\-generated outputs while adhering to company policies related to responsible AI use, data privacy, and security. The base pay range for this role is $102,220\.00 to $133,194\.00\. The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job\-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long\-term incentive compensation awards. jobs.description: **Opportunity:** Offerwall by Unity is a leading mobile advertising and monetization platform that empowers game developers to maximize revenue and engage users through rewarded experiences. For over a decade, we've connected millions of players with offers that provide tangible in\-app value, and we're now building the next generation of that product. At the center of it is Offer Delivery, the backend service that decides which offer a player sees, when, and on what terms. It operates on two fronts: bidding in real time into video ad auctions as a DSP, and placing offers directly outside the auction flow. Both are high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive, and revenue\-critical. We're seeking a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical leader for Offer Delivery. You will set the technical vision for the service, define its architecture, influence its roadmap, and drive delivery of it. You'll own how targeting, pacing, and supply\-side rules are expressed and enforced on the serving path. You'll coordinate closely with the auction, machine learning, platform, and product teams whose systems Offer Delivery sits between. As a technical leader on our Offerwall team, you will play a critical role in evolving our core monetization product, designing and implementing its next generation of technology. This is an exciting opportunity to lead impactful initiatives, architect robust solutions, and directly contribute to the financial success of countless mobile app developers and the engagement of millions of users globally. You will work at the intersection of rewarded advertising, advanced fraud prevention, and large\-scale data processing, driving innovation that directly impacts our bottom line and industry leadership. Your solutions will foster stronger collaboration and integration with other Ads products at Unity. You will mentor and guide engineers as they design, build, and deploy web applications and services. You will also play a key role in designing backend technical solutions that focus on system performance, reliability, and delivering business value at scale. **What you'll be doing:** * Architect \& Design: Lead the technical design and architecture for Offer Delivery services, features, and critical strategic initiatives, collaborating closely with senior engineers and managers. * Develop \& Innovate: Build, test, and operate the Golang services that power real\-time bidding into video auctions (OpenRTB) and direct offer placement outside the auction flow. * Raise the Bar: Mentor engineers, set engineering standards, and foster a culture of technical excellence on the team. * Drive Cross\-team Delivery: Ensure seamless communication and collaboration with product, Ad Viewer, teams in a distributed environment. * Operate \& Maintain: Ensure the high availability and reliability of our production services, including participation in on\-call rotations and proactive system monitoring. **What we're looking for:** * Technical Leadership: track record of owning a significant backend system, setting direction, making the architectural calls, and getting it delivered through others as well as yourself. * High\-scale distributed systems: Demonstrated ability to design and ship large\-scale, highly available, latency\-sensitive distributed services with complex business logic. * Core Technologies: Strong proficiency in backend development using Go (or clear ability to become effective in it quickly). The IRD for this job is: **09\-21\-2026** **ABOUT UC SANTA CRUZ** UC Santa Cruz is a public university like no other in California, combining the experience of a small, liberal arts college with the depth and rigor of a major research university. It's known as an unconventional place where innovation and experimentation is part of the campus's DNA. That playful, bold spirit still thrives today, all on a campus renowned as among the most beautiful in the world. **DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW** Originally founded in 1997, the Baskin School of Engineering is the first professional school at UC Santa Cruz. Over the past 20 years, Baskin Engineering has become a unique 21st\-century school of engineering and technology, characterized by evolutionary growth fueled by ongoing research opportunities that open new areas of intellectual inquiry. Baskin Engineering has grown to include six academic departments, various research centers, and institutes, and it has ambitious plans for further programmatic growth. The focus of Baskin Engineering's educational programming is to instill strong basic knowledge for sound practice in science and ethical engineering for the well\-being of society, and its diverse curricula facilitate creative thinking and prepare students for productive and rewarding careers. Baskin Engineering is focused on building collaborative connections and expanding instruction and research activities for faculty and students at UC Santa Cruz, both at its Santa Cruz campus and at its campus in Silicon Valley, the international center of technological innovation. Baskin Engineering champions new ideas and upholds the UCSC Principles of Community. The Baskin Engineering Lab Support (BELS) group operates and supports all specialized teaching labs in the Baskin School of Engineering. BELS provides hardware engineering, embedded software engineering, and technical support services specifically related to instruction for Baskin Engineering. BELS schedules services and operates the specialized undergraduate engineering teaching labs, including a small fabrication space at Baskin Engineering. BELS instructional labs are primarily located in the Baskin Engineering and Engineering 2 buildings, but at times, BELS supports instruction at other main campus buildings and off\-campus locations, such as Westside Research Park (WRP). BELS also provides technical advice, design, fabrication, poster printing, 3D printing services, laser cutting, circuit board fabrication, and equipment loans and rentals to undergraduate students, graduate students, researchers, and faculty, sometimes via recharge or miscellaneous fee reimbursement. Additionally, BELS operates the Baskin Engineering receiving services and provides support for audio\-visual equipment in the Baskin Engineering event spaces. More information can be found at https://bels.engineering.ucsc.edu/ **JOB SUMMARY** The BELS Teaching Lab Junior Engineer supports more than 20 lab courses across multiple departments and instructional spaces, directly impacting more than 1,600 students each quarter. jobs.description: **Current Employees:** If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet . **CORE JOB SUMMARY** The Assistant Scientist, GAB carries out a particular research agenda in support of the University’s research goals and objectives. Moreover, the Assistant Scientist, GAB contributes to the scientific community by publishing research findings and promotes the University’s reputation as a leader in the field. **CORE JOB FUNCTIONS** 1\. Contributes to basic and applied research activities and authors scientific publications, technical and agency reports, and patent preparations. 2\. Collaborates with senior staff to publish findings in refereed journals. 3\. Creates and conducts experiments and analyzes results. 4\. Works with other researchers to use and develop end products. 5\. Writes extramural proposals with approval from appropriate senior staff. 6\. Provides ready access to all experimental data for managing staff. 7\. Requests or acquires equipment and supplies for assigned project(s). 8\. Uses the Internet, surveys, legal documents, and other available sources to collect information. 9\. Applies for grants to continue research and prepares materials for submission to granting agencies and foundations. 10\. Adheres to University and unit\-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets. This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary. **CORE QUALIFICATIONS** Education: Doctorate degree \- Philosophy (PhD) required Experience: Minimum 1 year of relevant experience required Certification and Licensing: Refer to department description for applicable certification requirements Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: * Learning Agility: Ability to learn new procedures, technologies, and protocols, and adapt to changing priorities and work demands. * Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with others and contribute to a team environment. * Technical Proficiency: Skilled in using office software, technology, and relevant computer applications. Communication: Strong and clear written and verbal communication skills for interacting with colleagues and stakeholders. * This is a core job profile description and is not reflective of all duties that may be assigned to a specific position in each individual department. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and primary responsibilities of this core job profile. Specific duties and tasks may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned to the above consistent with the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for the job. **Department Specific Functions** Assist in R\&D relevant to the Smart Materials and Resilient Infrastructure (SMARIN) group, in conceptualization and regular brainstorming and communication, proposal development, use of AI and/or applied statistics for development of innovative solutions, project management, data analysis, manuscript preparation, active participation in professional conferences and journal article publishing, etc. **Department Specific Qualifications** **Education:** Ph.D. in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a related field; M.Sc. in applied statistics, data science, or a related field. **Certification and Licensing:** Type Here **Experience:** Minimum of 9 months of industry experience **Knowledge, Skills and Attitudes:** Poven track record in publishing scholarly articles as 1st author. Hand\-on expertise in cementitious materials science, life cycle assessment, etc. Self\-motivated researcher who can work effectively independently and in a multidisciplinary team environment. Ability and motivation to learn new skills to problem solve and grow professionally. The University of Miami is recognized as one of the nation’s premier research institutions and academic health systems and is among the largest employers in South Florida. With more than 20,000 faculty and staff, the University is committed to excellence and guided by a mission to positively impact the lives of students, patients, and communities locally and globally. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute meaningfully. United by shared values, the University community works together to build an environment defined by purpose, collaboration, and service. The University of Miami is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are protected from discrimination based on certain categories protected by Federal law. Click here for additional information. **Job Status:** Part time **Employee Type:** Staff

Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land\-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

You will be responsible for the following but not limited to: * Building the AI Gateway. Develop model\-agnostic routing services across Google Vertex (Gemini), AWS Bedrock (Claude), OpenAI, and open models (Phi, Gemma). Implement health\-aware load balancing, automatic failover, cost\-performance routing, JWT authentication, multi\-tenant routing, rate limiting, and quota enforcement. Build token management services (pre\-request estimation, post\-response logging, per\-BU cost attribution via PostgreSQL and BigQuery). * Contributing to the Agent Development Platform. Build core modules of the Verizon Agent SDK (Python primary, TypeScript secondary) with pre\-integrated LLMOps, FinOps, logging, memory, and MCP tool gateway. Deliver Agent Registry components — registration, versioning, capability discovery, lifecycle management, Agent Card schema. Build MCP Tool Gateway integrations: translation layer, Apigee connectivity, output validation, chain\-of\-thought tracing per tool call. * Owning platform reliability, SLOs, alerting, runbooks, and incident response for your services (MTTD \<15 min, MTTR \<60 min). Write IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) for K8s cluster provisioning across GCP and AWS. Build ETL/CDC pipelines from per\-namespace PostgreSQL to BigQuery/Athena for usage analytics and FinOps dashboards. Participate in on\-call rotation. * Shipping continuous evaluation and DevSecOps. Building the Agent DevSecOps pipeline: ArgoCD deployment manifests, canary rollout controllers (5% 25% 100%), and auto\-rollback triggers on accuracy dips or error spikes. Implement continuous evaluation pipelines: automated benchmarking, simulation harnesses, and RLAIF feedback loops. What we’re looking for… AI Engineer with a track record of maintaining high\-availability services and establishing robust operational frameworks. You possess deep expertise in large language model (LLM) infrastructure, transitioning complex research into scalable production environments with maintainable, high\-quality code, with a strong commitment to developer experience, you ensure that SDKs and APIs are intuitive, versioned, and resilient. You are highly proficient in Kubernetes and multi\-cloud architectures, demonstrating the strategic judgment to determine when to build internal solutions versus leveraging third\-party platforms. You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Experience in Python programming (production\-grade code, testing, packaging). * Experience insoftware engineering with production systems at scale. * Experience with LLM or AI infrastructure — model serving, inference APIs, or agent frameworks. * Experience with Kubernetes: deployments, services, ingress, HPA, secrets. * Experience with API design: REST/gRPC, JWT/OAuth2, rate limiting, versioning. * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and/or AWS): compute, networking, IAM, managed databases. * Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis in production. * Experience with CI/CD tooling: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Docker. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * A Master’s degree in Computer Science or AI/ML. * Experience with LLM serving frameworks (LLM Gateway, vLLM, TrueFoundry). * Experience with distributed systems patterns: eventual consistency, idempotency, circuit breakers, retry with backoff. * Experience with TypeScript or Go in production. * Experience with Istio service mesh (VirtualService, mTLS). * Experience building developer tools — SDKs, CLIs, or developer portals. * Experience with agentic AI patterns (ReAct, tool calling, multi\-agent orchestration). * Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) — MCP servers, tool schema design. * Experience with OpenTelemetry observability. * Experience with CDC/ETL tooling (Debezium, BigQuery). * Experience with security engineering (zero\-trust, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA). * Certifications: CKA/CKAD, AWS or GCP Cloud certifications. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high\-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to help us build what great agentic web operations look like in production, and turn those learnings into lasting value for the platform. You'll be one of the first people at Webflow to help shape what production\-grade agentic web operations actually looks like — not in theory, but live, with real enterprise accounts and real customers depending on the outcome. Reporting to Director, Solutions Architects, you'll work at the intersection of our product, sales, and engineering teams, turning first\-of\-kind deployments into the blueprints that shape Webflow's platform roadmap. **About the role:** =================== * Location: Remote\-first (United States) + This role will require an in\-person onboarding session in San Francisco, CA * Full\-time * Permanent * Exempt * The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location, job\-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. + United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States) - Zone A: $178,500 \- $210,000 - Zone B: $161,500 \- $196,000 - Zone C: $143,000 \- $184,000 * Application Information: + Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled + This posting is for a new position * Reporting to the Director, Solutions Architects As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll … * Partner closely with strategic enterprise accounts to map business\-critical marketing and web workflows * Design and build agentic workflows using Webflow APIs, CMS, components, and emerging AI capabilities * Build integrations between Webflow and external platforms (ad platforms, analytics, CRM, DAM, data pipelines) * Build in human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards, observability, rollback paths, and permission boundaries from day one * Help ensure every deployment holds up under production traffic, governance scrutiny, and real\-world constraints * Document where agentic workflows break down and identify which friction is systemic vs. customer\-specific * Create reusable architecture blueprints, reference implementations, and shared learnings after every engagement * Collaborate pre\-sale to de\-risk complex AI or integration concerns for strategic accounts **About you:** ============== Requirements: * 4\-6 years of experience in solutions engineering, forward deployment, or a customer\-facing technical role * Strong working knowledge of AI, APIs, automation, data pipelines, and integration architecture patterns * Strong front\-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks * Experience designing and supporting systems that manage live web properties at scale * Experience with workflow automation tools (n8n, etc.) * A track record of working through ambiguity, scoping projects, and delivering in first\-of\-kind contexts * Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed for embedded engagements You'll thrive as a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer if you: * Think holistically across systems, product, and risk * Have strong product intuition and know when to generalize versus customize a solution * Feel comfortable working within production constraints * Communicate trade\-offs clearly, including when the answer is no * Have experience with or genuine curiosity about agentic AI systems, LLM orchestration, and autonomous workflows * Are familiar with Webflow or similar visual development / CMS platforms * Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact. ### **Our Core Behaviors:** * **Build lasting customer trust.** We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first. * **Win together.** We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act. * **Reinvent ourselves.** We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible. * **Own it all the way.** We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers. ### **Benefits** * **Ownership in what you help build.** Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company. * **Health coverage that actually covers you.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full\-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums. * **Support for every stage of family life**. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6\+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions. * **Time off that's actually off.** Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired. * **Wellness for the whole you.** Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching. * **Invest in your future.** A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. * **Monthly stipends that flex with your life.** Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi\-Fi to workouts. * **Bonus for building together.** All full\-time, permanent, non\-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program. ### **Remote, together** At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job\-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. ### **Stay connected** Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor. ### **Please note:** *We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.* *To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.* *If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.* *For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review* *Webflow's Applicant Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer to join our AI Platforms and Enterprise Execution Group as part of Consumer Technology. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com. This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise‑scale strategic initiatives in reusable AI patterns that deliver business and customer value. This is a hands‑on, business facing, Principal Engineer role for a technical leader who designs, builds, and scales AI‑driven platforms, while operating at enterprise scope. The Principal Engineer serves as a technical authority who codes, prototypes, and reviews architecture, not just oversees execution **In this role, you will:** * Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology executives, influencing enterprise strategy and guiding the development of applications, platforms, security, data, and AI capabilities that address complex business challenges and create measurable customer and business value. * Lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, and modernization initiatives by partnering with business leaders to identify opportunities, shape use cases, and translate emerging technologies into practical business outcomes. * Translate enterprise business objectives, customer needs, and operational challenges into scalable engineering solutions, including reusable architectures, AI\-enabled platforms, and production\-grade capabilities that accelerate adoption across the organization. * Partner directly with senior executives, product leaders, and engineering teams to evaluate strategic priorities, define AI roadmaps, establish success metrics, and communicate technical opportunities, tradeoffs, risks, and implementation strategies. * Maintain deep awareness of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advances in AI, proactively identifying innovations that improve productivity, decision\-making, customer experiences, operational efficiency, and competitive advantage. * Mobilize and influence large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives by aligning business and technology stakeholders, resolving complex challenges, and serving as the senior technical authority for critical platform, data, and AI decisions. * Drive AI opportunity discovery and executive ideation sessions, helping business leaders identify, prioritize, and mature high\-value use cases while establishing clear business outcomes, investment rationale, and adoption strategies. **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 7\+ years of senior engineering experience, including architecture and hands‑on delivery of large‑scale platforms and systems * 4\+ years of experience developing or deploying AI‑powered tools, chatbots, LLM‑based automation, or agentic workflows, including understanding of AI risks, observability needs, and stakeholder communication * 3\+ years of hands‑on experience across Cloud architectures including Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, AWS, etc. and internal platforms such as Tachyon * 3\+ years of experience operating at both keyboard‑level technical depth and executive‑level technical storytelling **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience leading technology strategy and delivery within agile product operating models in large, complex enterprises, including cloud\-native platforms and modern software engineering practices. * Financial services experience preferred; Business Banking domain experience is beneficial but not required * Demonstrated ability to mentor and influence senior technical talent, establish engineering standards, and elevate architecture and delivery practices across multiple teams and organizations. * Proven ability to engage and influence senior business executives, translating strategic priorities and operational challenges into high\-impact AI use cases, technology roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes. * Demonstrated experience evaluating, prototyping, and scaling Generative and Agentic AI capabilities while balancing innovation, risk management, governance, and responsible AI principles. * Strong organizational savvy, executive presence, and customer centricity, with the ability to influence senior leaders, navigate complex enterprise environments, and align technology investments to measurable business outcomes * Experience partnering directly with business executives and product leaders to identify strategic opportunities, shape technology roadmaps, and translate business objectives into scalable solutions. * Experience building or scaling enterprise AI platforms, developer frameworks, reusable services, or shared capabilities that accelerate adoption across multiple business domains. * Ability to evaluate technology investments through a business value lens, including defining success metrics, prioritizing opportunities, and articulating ROI to executive stakeholders. * Experience delivering technology solutions within highly regulated industries, balancing innovation with security, compliance, audit, and risk management requirements. * Proven ability to drive enterprise adoption of emerging technologies through influence, stakeholder engagement, and cross\-functional change leadership. **Job Expectations:** * Flexibility to work across global teams * Ability to travel as needed * This position offers a hybrid work schedule * This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship **Job Location**: 333 Market St \- San Francisco, California 94105 300 S. Brevard \- Charlotte, North Carolina 28202 2600 S Price Rd \- Chandler, Arizona 85286 3075 Loyalty Cir \-COLUMBUS, OH 43219 **Pay Range** Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities. $159,000\.00 \- $305,000\.00**Benefits** Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits \- Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees. * Health benefits * 401(k) Plan * Paid time off * Disability benefits * Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance * Parental leave * Critical caregiving leave * Discounts and savings * Commuter benefits * Tuition reimbursement * Scholarships for dependent children * Adoption reimbursement **Posting End Date:** 24 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more. **Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:** a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo. b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer, Lead
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Our first\-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting\-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway. **Role Overview** ----------------- The Accelerator Platform Software (APS) team owns the software closest to the metal: the host\-side platform layer, the device\-side runtime and firmware, the Linux\-based device OS, the simulation and emulation environments we use to build software ahead of silicon, performance and debug tooling, and product security. If it touches the accelerator, it goes through us. We build with AI\-native workflows, where agentic coding tools, a shared skills repository, and automation are core to how the team ships. This role sits on the Director's staff and owns making that leverage real across every sub\-team. Most companies would staff an entire developer\-systems team for this mission. We are hiring one person and giving them the whole thing. You will be the engineer who makes AI\-assisted development actually work in a shop where the code talks to registers and a wrong answer means a hung device, not a bad paragraph. You will embed with each sub\-team, find where their week goes, and build agentic workflows that give it back, then prove the gains with evaluations rather than enthusiasm. You report directly to the Director of APS, and your roadmap is yours to define from the friction you observe. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Forward deployment and workflow building*** Embed with APS sub\-teams across firmware, runtime, performance, and simulation, and build agentic workflows into how they actually work, including coding, debugging, triage, test generation, and keeping documentation honest. * Pair directly with senior engineers on their real work, earning adoption by making their week measurably better. **Tooling and shared infrastructure*** Own the shared skills repository and internal agent tooling that turn hard\-won team knowledge into reusable, evaluated automation. * Wire agents into CI and everyday engineering surfaces, including code review, log and trace triage, and silicon\-debug assistance. **Quality and evaluation*** Build and maintain evaluations so workflow quality is measured rather than guessed, and regression\-test the automation like any other production system. **Standards and culture*** Set the standard for what good AI\-assisted engineering looks like where correctness is non\-negotiable, and champion that AI\-native culture across the team. * Identify where AI leverage genuinely pays off and where it does not, and say so plainly. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * A strong software engineering background, with systems or infrastructure experience strongly preferred; this is an engineering role, not a prompt\-writing role. * Hands\-on, expert experience using agentic development tools such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, integrating LLM APIs, and building evaluations. * A shipped track record of internal tooling or developer\-productivity work that engineers actually adopted. * The credibility and patience to win over skeptical senior systems engineers with results rather than demos. * Self\-directed working style, comfortable defining your own roadmap from observed friction without a team around you. * Excellent written communication skills, since we run on written plans, design docs, and async updates. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * A low\-level or hardware\-adjacent background, enough to be credible pairing on a kernel driver or a trace\-analysis session. * Experience with CI/CD systems, developer platforms, or build and release engineering. * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions\-engineering, or platform\-team experience. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * You will own a mission most companies spread across an entire team, with a roadmap you define and a direct line to the Director of APS. * You will shape what AI\-native engineering looks like at a company building production AI inference hardware, where your tooling directly accelerates the software that turns silicon into a product. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $325,000 – $400,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off, and we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** At Avenue Z, we are a dynamic media and technology company with a powerful influence across all channels. Our leadership has been at the forefront of digital marketing and communications for over 30 years, pioneering innovative strategies that drive meaningful change in brand performance and business growth. When you join Avenue Z, you become part of a team that doesn’t just adapt to change but leads it, guiding some of the world’s most influential leaders and brands to new heights. We are driven by a deep passion for our craft and an unwavering commitment to integrity in everything we do. If you share our passion and values, explore our current job openings to see how you can make an impact with us.**The role** ------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to build and ship the agent systems that run social commerce for our brands and for our own platform. You will embed with the teams doing the work, performance media, creator and influencer, ecommerce, and analytics, find the process where throughput is lost or money is left on the table, and build a production agent that owns it. Then you move to the next one. Concretely, this is work like: agents that detect and re\-authorize expiring TikTok Shop affiliate codes and Meta partnership permissions before spend stalls, systems that reallocate ad budget toward top\-performing creators automatically, pipelines that launch new creator content across every platform daily without a human touching it, and reporting infrastructure that tells a brand what actually drove GMV. You own the problem end to end: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, evals, adoption, and what breaks at 2am. If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary range: $90,000 \- $100,000 USD * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.
